description: A proposal freezes exact inputs and yields execution until an authorized current human decision.

assertions: Runtime proof is bound to issuing credential and runtime.

steps.action: Request decision with committed input artifact and checkpoint
assertions: Run ends paused; proposal input digest and versions are fixed.
Human session is required regardless of token scope labels.
Approval is preserved; no execution lease exists yet.

steps.action: Change approved execution intent through metadata PATCH
assertions: Approval cannot apply to different inputs or scope.

steps.action: Claim and verify approved input digest/current policy
assertions: New run/fence; a prior paused attempt never resumes.
